name: Shiftlane
summary: A deploy and CI dashboard where pipelines stream their logs live and rollouts light up a world map
about: A nine-page deployment dashboard for the platform team of a freight company, in graphite with electric mint and violet. A pipeline runs step by step on the overview while its log lines stream in, and when it ships, the deploy map sends arcs out from Frankfurt and lights up ten regions wave by wave. Projects, runs, deployments with rollback, environments and variables, incidents, metrics, team and settings all work and keep their data in the browser.
how: Watch the live pipeline on the Overview: stages tick over, log lines stream in and the map lights up when it ships
Open Pipelines to pick a run, click a job in the stage graph, search its log or show only warnings and errors
Press Run pipeline or Deploy to start your own run, or choose a failing test to see a red build
On Deployments, roll production back, promote a staging build or drain a region and watch the map follow
Add, reveal, edit or delete environment variables, declare an incident and post updates until it is resolved
Switch the metrics range between 1h, 24h, 7d and 30d, change access on the Team page and invite people
Press Ctrl+K to jump anywhere, and reset the demo data in Settings
